mapper.select: SELECT s.id, COALESCE(j.bpm_unit, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.music.bpmUnit'))) AS bpm_unit, s.note_count, s.score_version, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM song_score_versions v WHERE v.song_id = s.id AND v.score_version <> s.score_version) AS has_archived_score FROM songs s LEFT JOIN jangdans j ON j.id = s.jangdan_id WHERE s.id = #{songId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.is_scorable AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND CAST(COALESCE(j.bpm_unit, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.music.bpmUnit'))) AS BINARY) IN ('QUARTER', 'DOTTED_QUARTER', 'JEONGGAN', 'JANGDAN_BEAT')

SELECT ps.id AS session_id, ps.user_id, ps.song_id, ps.bpm, ps.bpm_unit, ps.start_note_idx, ps.end_note_idx, ps.status, ps.score_version, e.id AS evaluation_id, ps.fail_reason, (ps.recording_url IS NOT NULL AND ps.record_deleted_at IS NULL) AS recording_available, ps.started_at, ps.ended_at, ps.analysis_started_at, ps.saved_at, ps.memo, ps.viewed_at, COALESCE(v.title, s.title) AS song_title, CASE WHEN ps.analysis_timing_attempt = ps.analysis_attempt THEN ps.analysis_timing_id END AS analysis_timing_id FROM practice_sessions ps JOIN songs s ON s.id = ps.song_id LEFT JOIN song_score_versions v ON v.song_id = ps.song_id AND v.score_version = ps.score_version AND s.score_version != ps.score_version LEFT JOIN evaluations e ON e.session_id = ps.id WHERE ps.id = #{sessionId} AND ps.user_id = #{userId} AND ps.record_deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE practice_sessions SET recording_url = #{recordingUrl}, recording_bytes = #{bytes}, recording_duration_ms = #{durationMs}, recording_sample_rate = #{sampleRate}, recording_channels = #{channels}, ended_at = #{uploadedAt}, status = 'PENDING', analysis_timing_attempt = analysis_attempt + 1, analysis_attempt = analysis_attempt + 1, analysis_started_at = #{uploadedAt}, analysis_timing_id = #{timingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'RECORDING'
